otherFeatures: Accelerometer, gyro, hall, proximity, touch sensors, VPU
Bluetooth profiles A2DP, AVRCP, HFP; LE Audio support announced
Case is not water resistant (only earbuds IPX7)

bluetooth.notes: The name starts with 'Galaxy Buds2 Pro'. The ' (XXXX)' 4-character suffix follows the usual Galaxy Buds naming but no source found spelling it out for this model, so treat it as unverified. It can be renamed in Galaxy Wearable; a SamMobile review screenshot shows a renamed 'Samsung's Buds2 Pro'. Check the Pro pattern before plain 'Galaxy Buds2', because 'Galaxy Buds2' also prefix-matches. GalaxyBudsClient matches by name.Contains('Buds2 Pro') and otherwise by SPP service UUID prefix d908aab5-7a90-4cbe-8641-86a553db + device ID. It also treats a device with SPP-new + Handsfree + LE Audio UUIDs as Buds2 Pro. Galaxy Wearable app needed for extras.

pairingSteps: Put both earbuds in the charging case (if the earbud light does not flash, charge the case for 10+ minutes).
Close the case lid, then open it. The earbuds enter Bluetooth pairing mode automatically; Samsung phones show a connect pop-up.
On other phones, turn on Bluetooth and select 'Galaxy Buds2 Pro' (or use the Galaxy Wearable app).
If they are not found or already paired elsewhere: with the buds in the open case, touch and hold both earbuds for more than 3 seconds. The earbud lights flash red, green and blue in pairing mode.
Pairing mode turns off after 3 minutes; close and reopen the case to try again.
